scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run desktop:prepare && npm install --prefix apps/desktop && npm run dist --prefix apps/desktop
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run desktop:prepare && npm install --prefix apps/desktop && npm run dist:publish --prefix apps/desktop
